notes: Dense relational/negation doc: reversed payer/payee and dropped negations (never, not $X, no longer) are the main trap; 13 relational checks cover every money/favor relation.
$comment_relational: kind: payment|loan|debt|discount|self-paid|none. For payment/loan/debt the grader checks payer -> payee direction and amount; for discount/self-paid/none it checks the stated `relation` sentence and the negation, because no money moved in that direction (Codex review, PR #13).
